profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at VES LLC
profile.summary: Experienced System Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the automotive and defense industries. Skilled in Java, Continuous Integration, Maven, Spring Boot, and PCF.  Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science focused in Computer Science and Engineering from University of Toledo and a Masters of Science in Software Engineering from The University of Michigan-Dearborn.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Development Modernization - Vehicle Domain Services

•	Containerized microservices using Docker and Kubernetes to automate testing in local and build environments
•	Interviewed candidates periodically to fill various developer positions to provide technical evaluations to hiring manager
•	Illustrated software craftsmanship by using design patterns to create extensible and reusable architecture designs
•	Amplified team impact by articulating requirements, offering technical insight, and coaching a team of 25 developers
•	Designed REST APIs with OpenApi and Swagger code generation with contract tests to ensure client response matches
•	Incorporated continuous integration and continuous delivery via Jenkins Pipeline to deploy scalable PCF cloud services
•	Collaborated and significantly contributed to the development of over 34 cloud services and provided technical leadership
•	Automated application monitoring with Prometheus for availability alerting and Grafana dashboard metrics visualization
•	Owned performance testing, tuning, and DevOps for microservices with an active user base of 15 million at peak load of 600K requests per hour

positions.title: TDSE Software and Electrical Co-Op
positions.description:
• Linux configuration and shell scripting.
• Practice object oriented design and software engineering principles. 
• Deployment of software and server administration/configuration onto Windows and Linux based operating systems.
• Designed a custom module in LabVIEW for a machine vision and image processing/analysis application.
• Aid in the development, enhancement, testing, and support for real-time embedded glass inspection systems in C/C++.

positions.title: Junior Technology Associate
positions.description:
Worked with Java Websphere Commerce, performing JUnit testing code. Aided in the development of  modules using JavaBeans to encapsulate e-commerce site visitor demographics data.
Was responsible for coordinating the activities and leading a team of 10 interns in a DotNetNuke website development effort for the Center for Families and Children (Cleveland, Ohio).

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description: • Developed a website with a team of 5 volunteers over the course of a weekend in DotNetNuke.

positions.title: Junior Technology Associate
positions.description:
• Managed a large work queue by prioritizing, and remaining resourceful
• Gave accurate time estimates for projects and completed them in a timely manner
• Developed websites, landing pages, and templates for Pirelli, Rogers Wireless, Bristol-Myers Squibb
• Led a team of ten people to develop a website for the Children's Interstitial Lung Disease Foundation

positions.title: Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
• Hydraulic vibration testing on electrical components
• Collected and analyzed data with test documentation and report writing
• Fabrication and installation of CAN bus wiring harnesses onto semi trucks
• Worked with a team to complete tasks and thrived under proper project management

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
• Provided computer support for students and faculty
• Communicated between colleagues to solve problems
• Established security to stop emails from being harvested and spammed
• Worked to integrate a more efficient data management system on the server

company.name: The University Of Toledo's Engineering College Computing

organizations.name: Alpha Kappa Psi
organizations.position: Student Member, Last Rocket Standing Chair, Pledge Class Professional Chair · Feb 2012 - Dec 2013
organizations.description:
Student Member

Last Rocket Standing Chair
• Led a committee in organizing a comedy event, at which we had over 300 attendees
• Responsible for coordinating committee for local business outreach for raffle donations
• Raised over $1,200 for my Fraternity through this effort

Pledge Chair:
• Cooperated with other chair members and pledge brothers to plan events. 
• Interviewed membership, studied Fraternity history, and utilized time management. 
• Communicated with the pledge class through email, social media, and via phone. 
• Seeked out professional events in the local area and coordinated a professional event for the chapter.
